ground_truth_use: evaluation only; no Replica depth, camera trajectory, or GT geometry is read by E1a-E4a selection/refinement
depth_resampling: nearest neighbor to MASt3R-SLAM long-edge-512 resize and center crop
gt_world_transform: per-frame Replica camera-to-world pose from traj.txt
sim3_alignment: one scene-level Sim(3) fit from B0 across every Keyframe, then reused for B0-B3
surface_metric: scene-level nearest-neighbor precision/recall/F-score on deterministic 2x2 pixel lattice
normal_metric: absolute-dot angular error between pointmap and GT-depth world normals
boundary_metric: absolute change in adjacent 3D point spacing across fixed SAB3R semantic boundaries

geometry_only_regions.region_note: 4-connected seed-anchored plane growing; semantics are not read; fixed from validation before any test run

methods.B1: geometry-only frame-local Regions with common frozen bounded plane optimizer
methods.B2: SAB3R semantic frame-local Regions, no temporal merge, same optimizer
methods.B3: SAB3R semantic persistent Regions with temporal merge, same optimizer
methods.B4: not run unless GT semantic/plane masks are present; Replica export contains paired depth and trajectory only

threshold_status: error score/selection threshold frozen from two scene-level validation runs; no test GT or test scene used
